'''Republic Marshalls''' were the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] presence on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and subsequent [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Marshall [[Kay Cavarat]] served as the chief [[Police officer/Legends|law enforcement officer]] for the [[Belsavis prison]]. The Marshalls administered the prison [[Warden/Legends|wardens]] who in turn commanded the prison guards. The Marshalls were also responsible for any law enforcement activity on the planet.
